title: B1 Core Capstone: Önálló magyar nyelvhasználat (Consolidation)
grammar: Grand synthesis of all B1 grammar structures, communicative agility, and idioms

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can retell in a few sentences what happens at Eger Castle in the story.
I can use bár... mégis and the particles and idioms of this unit.
I can say that I speak Hungarian on my own and with confidence.
I can say that language proficiency is the result of persistence.
